title: MoE-SpAc: Efficient MoE Inference Based on Speculative Activation Utility in Heterogeneous Edge Scenarios
abstract: arXiv:2603.09983v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models enable scalable performance but face severe memory constraints on edge devices. Existing offloading strategies struggle with I/O bottlenecks due to the dynamic, low-information nature of autoregressive expert activation. In this paper, we propose to repurpose Speculative Decoding (SD) not merely as a compute accelerator, but as an informative lookahead sensor for memory management, supported by our theoretical and empirical analyses. Hence, we introduce MoE-SpAc, an MoE inference framework that integrates a Speculative Utility Estimator to track expert demand, a Heterogeneous Workload Balancer to dynamically partition computation via online integer optimization, and an Asynchronous Execution Engine to unify the prefetching and eviction in the same utility space. translated_title: MoE-SpAc：异构边缘场景下基于投机激活效用的高效MoE推理框架
translated_abstract: 混合专家模型能够实现可扩展的性能，但在边缘设备上面临严重的内存限制。由于自回归专家激活具有动态性和低信息量特性，现有的卸载策略难以应对I/O瓶颈。本文提出将投机解码重新定位，不仅作为计算加速器，更作为内存管理的信息前瞻传感器，这一提议得到了我们理论分析和实证分析的支持。因此，我们提出MoE-SpAc，一个MoE推理框架，它集成了用于追踪专家需求的投机效用估计器、通过在线整数优化动态划分计算的异构工作负载均衡器，以及在相同效用空间中统一预取与逐出操作的异步执行引擎。在七个基准测试上的大量实验表明，MoE-SpAc相对于基于投机解码的SOTA基线，TPS提升了42%……
tldr: 提出MoE-SpAc框架，将投机解码创新性地重新用作内存管理的前瞻传感器，通过投机效用估计器、异构工作负载均衡器和异步执行引擎，在统一的效用空间中协调专家预取与逐出，使异构边缘设备上的MoE推理TPS较SOTA基线提升42%。
en_tdlr: MoE-SpAc repurposes Speculative Decoding as an informative lookahead sensor for memory management, integrating a speculative utility estimator, a heterogeneous workload balancer, and an asynchronous execution engine to coordinate expert prefetching and eviction in a unified utility space, achieving 42% TPS improvement over the SOTA SD-based baseline for efficient MoE inference in heterogeneous edge scenarios.
